method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A toy arm of cylinders and boxes, plain primitives, a mid grey floor.
notes.fix: Filleted castings, joint housings and a cable run, tight on the gripper over the glowing pocket, the floor outside the pool to black.

notes.problem: A toy arm, no button visible, a six pocket box that contradicts slide 1, a plain cup crucible.
notes.fix: A modelled six axis arm closed on a glowing button over slide 1's copper_hearth, the base cropped off the right edge.

notes.problem: Primitive arm, unlabelled rule, floating stations.
notes.fix: Low macro tight on the gripper holding the glowing button, the wrist casting filling a third of the frame.

notes.problem: A beige slab in the grey middle, a thick flat ring for the mark.
notes.fix: Near edge on so only the sheet edges catch the key, a thin paint pen stroke.

notes.problem: A flat tan slab with regular stripes, no seated contact, a rubber band mark, mid tones under a navy wall.
notes.fix: The long edge takes the key, offset curled top sheets, a contact, a brushed stroke on the dome.

notes.problem: Flat tan slab, a painted band, empty lower floor.
notes.fix: Camera at about 0.15 m, stack off the bottom and left edges on its shadow side, a thin pen line for the mark.

notes.problem: A smooth tan lower right gradient, stepped dome rings.
notes.fix: Milled arc roughness, more dome segments.

notes.problem: Stepped dome rings, a pale lower right gradient without milled arcs, a flat navy wall with a seam.
notes.fix: Smoother dome normals, the milled arc roughness, less key on the right copper.

notes.problem: A flat orange copper gradient on the right, no scale.
notes.fix: Tighten onto the glowing pocket, copper falling to black on the right, a tong tip for scale.

notes.problem: 72 dogbones at relief height 10 read as an embossed calendar tile, a hard plate edge, labels outside the safe zone.
notes.fix: Real height with fillets, an oblique crop bleeding off the right and bottom, labels inside the margin.

notes.problem: Dogbones read as I glyphs on a rectangular plate.
notes.fix: Wider grips with radiused fillets, the plate running off the left and bottom edges.

notes.problem: The pool on the first 17 bars reads as elapsed months.
notes.fix: Rake the bars evenly, or light exactly the elapsed months and say so.

notes.problem: Two flat trays under a dead band, a vent grille at feed size.
notes.fix: Lower and push in so the 249 tray bleeds off the right, scuffed bevelled tops, the pool on the 41 filled wells.

notes.problem: Two flat dark trays in a quarter of the frame, a dead band, a pegboard field.
notes.fix: Push in and lower so the long tray runs off the right edge, bevel catch lights and scuffs.

notes.problem: The 249 well tray reads as a grille at 432 px.
notes.fix: Pool on the filled corner, empty wells to true black, a lower camera for rim highlights.

notes.problem: Starred apexes like chocolate kisses, near heaps under the footer.
notes.fix: Rounded slumped crowns with avalanche facets, near heaps clear of the footer.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
rounds_note: 3 of 3 judge card(s) in this invocation had already been scored, so this was a re-combination rather than a scoring round and the round count did not advance. Re-run the judges to score again
shortfall: at the round cap the finished deck ships at 7.15, 0.85 under the 8.0 top rung. Name that in the email and the run record
craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.5 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
